preamble.summary: Isaiah 17 is the DAMASCUS / EPHRAIM ORACLE — the joint-judgment of Aram-Damascus and Northern-Israel (the Syro-Ephraimite-coalition that-threatened-Ahaz at-chapter-7). The chapter shifts at-vv. 12–14 to a brief-oracle-against-the-roaring-nations.
preamble.notable_variants: 17:7 'in that day man will look to his Maker' theological-pivot; 17:10 'you have forgotten the God of your salvation' charge; 17:13 'nations roar like the roaring of many waters' → Rev 17:15.
preamble.structural_notes: MT Isaiah 17 = LXX Isaiah 17. 14 verses. DAMASCUS / EPHRAIM oracle.

variant_notes: 'An oracle concerning Damascus. Behold, Damascus will cease to be a city and will become a heap of ruins' tracks MT. DAMASCUS-CEASES — fulfilled-732-BCE Tiglath-Pileser-III's-conquest.
'The cities of Aroer are deserted; they will be for flocks, which will lie down, and none will make them afraid' tracks MT.
'The fortress will disappear from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus; and the remnant of Syria will be like the glory of the children of Israel, declares the LORD of hosts' tracks MT.
'And in that day the glory of Jacob will be brought low, and the fat of his flesh will grow lean' tracks MT.
'And it shall be as when the reaper gathers standing grain and his arm harvests the ears, and as when one gleans the ears of grain in the Valley of Rephaim' tracks MT.

'Gleanings will be left in it, as when an olive tree is beaten — two or three berries in the top of the highest bough, four or five on the branches of a fruit tree' tracks MT. GLEANINGS-REMAIN — remnant-theology.
'In that day man will look to his Maker, and his eyes will look on the Holy One of Israel' tracks MT. LOOK-TO-HIS-MAKER. Theological-pivot. Genesis 1:26's-imago-Dei language echoed.

'He will not look to the altars, the work of his hands, and he will not look on what his own fingers have made, either the Asherim or the altars of incense' tracks MT. ASHERIM — Canaanite-fertility-goddess-poles condemned.

'In that day their strong cities will be like the deserted places of the wooded heights and the hilltops, which they deserted because of the children of Israel, and there will be desolation' tracks MT.

'For you have forgotten the God of your salvation and have not remembered the Rock of your refuge; therefore, though you plant pleasant plants and sow the vine-branch of a stranger' tracks MT. ROCK-OF-REFUGE divine-title. 1 Cor 10:4 ('that rock was Christ') Christologically-extends.
'Though on the day that you plant it you make it grow, and on the morning that you sow it you bring it to bud, yet the harvest will flee away in a day of grief and incurable pain' tracks MT.

'Ah, the thunder of many peoples; they thunder like the thundering of the sea! Ah, the roar of nations; they roar like the roaring of mighty waters!' tracks MT. NATIONS-ROAR-LIKE-WATERS. Revelation 17:15 ('the waters that you saw, where the prostitute is seated, are peoples and multitudes and nations and languages') Christologically-extends. Pss 65:7, 93:3-4 share the imagery.

'The nations roar like the roaring of many waters, but he will rebuke them, and they will flee far away, chased like chaff on the mountains before the wind and whirling dust before the storm' tracks MT. CHAFF-BEFORE-WIND. Ps 1:4 echo.

'At evening time, behold, terror! Before morning, they are no more! This is the portion of those who loot us, and the lot of those who plunder us' tracks MT. AT-EVENING-TERROR / BEFORE-MORNING-NO-MORE — Sennacherib-overnight pattern (// 2 Kgs 19:35).
